issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect Course.ratings to be an array of Int, but the solution defines Course.ratings as [Double] and then uses it as if it contained Int values (appending Int in addRating and summing into an Int accumulator in getAverageRating). This creates a type conflict between artifacts and makes the solution internally inconsistent (would not compile) and contradicts the exercise specification that ratings are Int values.
issues.suggested_fix: Align the ratings type across all artifacts. The simplest fix is to change the solution to use ratings: [Int] (matching the problem statement and template). Update the initializer signature to accept [Int], ensure addRating(stars:) appends Int values, and have getAverageRating() sum Ints and return Double(sum) / Double(count). Alternatively, if you prefer Double ratings, update the problem statement and template to declare ratings as [Double] and adapt addRating and getAverageRating accordingly — but keep the type consistent in all three artifacts.
